# Tafa Belli Brown

> Portfolio of Tafa Belli Brown, a full-stack web developer building production web applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://tafabellibrown.vercel.app/): Profile, skills, experience, and contact information.
- [Projects](https://tafabellibrown.vercel.app/projects): Projects and engineering case studies.
- [Blog](https://tafabellibrown.vercel.app/blog): Technical articles and development notes.
- [Services](https://tafabellibrown.vercel.app/services): Web development services.
